description: Read one lead's customer messages, oldest to newest: { at, channel, direction (inbound = from the customer, outbound = sent by the business), text (up to 2000 characters; truncated is true when cut), media ({ kind, contentType, name } or null — the file itself is never returned) }. A person who writes on two channels has two separate conversations: pass channel to read one, omit it to get all channels interleaved by time. Returns the most recent `limit` messages (default 30, max 100). Use it before drafting a reply or to answer what the customer asked. Read-only — this server cannot send messages. Use list_conversations to find leads with messages and get_lead for the lead card.

channel.description: Channel slug to read (e.g. instagram, telegram, olx), as returned by list_conversations. Omit for every channel.

leadId.description: The lead id returned by list_conversations or search_leads.

limit.description: How many of the newest messages to return (default 30).

name: get_lead_conversation
title: Get lead conversation
